With 100 members, limit 50: totalPages = 3 (correct is 2), and from page 2 clicking next sets offset=100, yielding zero members while currentPage (floor(100/50)+1=3) equals totalPages, so the empty page is reachable. Off-by-one is verifiable directly from the diff.

judged_text: totalPages computes Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1, which overstates the page count by one whenever user_count is an exact multiple of limit, and the next action (lines 29-38) clamps offset to user_count, so the pager navigates the admin onto an empty page. For a group with exactly 100 members and limit 50, totalPages is 3, so from page 2 the admin can click next to offset 100; the server returns zero members and the admin sees an empty '3/3' member list.
